prediction.likelyOutcome: Partial summary judgment is likely to be granted on liability (and most damages) against Tres Botes in favor of SMK given clean admissions and a sale-clause defense that fails on timing, while summary judgment against Dos Botes in favor of SDP is likely to be denied or only partially granted because of genuine fact disputes over renewal execution, SDP's own 2013 conveyance, and Dos Botes's prior-breach defense, sending that claim to trial with materially higher uncertainty.

figures.label: Total rent claimed (4 months delinquent + remaining term)
figures.quote: The petition alleged Tres Botes thus breached the lease and owed $189,200, representing four months' delinquent rent and forty-four months remaining on the lease.

issues.label: SDP v. Dos Botes — Future Rent on Disputed Renewal

figures.label: Total rent claimed (36 months remaining on renewed term)
figures.quote: The petition argued Dos Botes thus breached the lease and owed $324,000, representing the thirty -six months remaining in the renewed lease term .

outcome.description: Trial court (judgment signed September 22, 2025) granted summary judgment awarding SMK $79,096.44 against Tres Botes (18 months plus one prorated month at $4,300 until the property was sold) and SDP $108,000 against Dos Botes (12 months at $9,000 until relet), $187,096.44 total; no attorney's fees mentioned. On appeal the $79,096.44 award to SMK was affirmed; the $108,000 award to SDP was reversed and remanded because SDP did not conclusively prove the lease was renewed.
outcome.finalNote: $79,096.44 affirmed; the $108,000 Dos Botes award reversed and remanded, so the final total could rise.
